answers.answer: 1. 1. Three Pods. 2. Randomly choose; lowest number in Section A, next in B, then alternate A/B; all Locked side up. 3. Bag: 1 Blank, 4 Larvae, 1 Creeper, 1 Queen, 3 Adults plus 1 additional Adult per player (4-player total: 7 Adults).

answers.answer: 1. 1. Remove cards marked for more players than present; shuffle Personal and Corporate separately and deal one of each to each player, kept hidden. 2. answers.answer: 1. 1. Reveal the tile and token; orient tile so token’s number faces the printed Item Counter. 2. Resolve its effect and remove the token to the box. 3. Ordinarily roll Noise only if destination empty; place marker in numbered connected Corridor (or resolve Encounter if already marked). 4. Silence suppresses roll; Danger resolves movement/all eligible adjacent Intruders, or places Noise in every empty connected Corridor if none; if any Character or Intruder occupies destination, no ordinary Movement Noise roll.

Action and Contamination cards both count.

answers.answer: 1. 1. No; all players do not each take exactly one round then automatically trigger Event. Rounds repeat until all players pass. 2. Empty hand after two Actions does not itself pass; declare Pass on next round. 4. Player Phase ends once all have passed; then Event Phase.
